author: Dale Philip
description: I visited the Setia Alam Night Market (Pasar Malam Setia Alam) in Selangor Malaysia, which is famously the longest night market in the country. It was so crowded and with so many distractions that I accidentally booted a guy's money collection bucket, but with the help of some friendly passerbys I was able to pick it all up without any trouble.
title: I Kicked the Bucket in Selangor, Malaysia 🇲🇾
